meta.notes: Generated by reverse-engineering the live prototype's own theme file (src/tokens/ds/themes/codm.css) and system-constant token tiers (space.css, system.css) — NOT from reference imagery or a brand deck. Every value under codashop.brandLocked is cited to a specific CSS declaration and is meant to be machine-checked against that same file by tools/style-guide-check.mjs, so it stays honest by construction: if the theme file changes, this spec is what will report as stale. The 'generic' block's brand-voice fields (essence, artStyle, motifs, assetPrompts, texture) are intentionally omitted rather than fabricated — no source imagery or copy was reviewed to ground them. JSON-only deliverable; no guide.html was produced for this store.

primary.usage: brand yellow — CTA/glow, primary ramp seed

typography.notes: Repo has no separate desktop type scale — the prototype renders in a fixed mobile device frame, so mobile == the only authored scale (source: codm.css comment 'Mobile mode — the store renders in a mobile frame').

generic._note: Fields set to null above require reference imagery or written brand guidance this session did not have access to. Do not backfill them with invented copy — regenerate from real source material instead.

codashop.architectureNote: 5-tier cascade: (1) type primitives + ref seeds -> (2) palette ramps (--x-palette-{role}-500 = --x-ref-{role}) -> (3) sys intensity/dimensions/effects/states -> (4) semantic defaults (--x-bg-*, --x-text-*, --x-border-*) -> (5) .text-style-* classes. COD:M is the REFERENCE surface set: its L1-L3 container-surface values ARE the system.css :root defaults, so codm.css declares no surface overrides for them (see codm.css comment, line ~234). THREE override layers apply here exactly as in the master schema: SYSTEM CONSTANT (layoutSystem, radius/space/stroke/elevation scale in space.css, the .text-style-* composition — never changes, shared verbatim with every other store including FCM) > BRAND-LOCKED (the 7 ref seeds, font families, condense factor, per-slot pixel overrides below) > STORE-FLEXIBLE (semantic colour mapping — not itemised in this JSON-only pass).

layoutSystem.containerRule: device screen sets container-type:inline-size; overlay must NOT (traps position:fixed)
layoutSystem.note: System constant — identical for every store in this repo, COD:M included. Not re-derived per store; see docs/grid-layout-system.md for the authoritative breakpoint/grid table.

themePreset.name: Call of Duty: Mobile
themePreset.borderRadius: control-full stays the shared 2px system default (not overridden to a pill — contrast with FCM, which overrides this to 999px)

palette.anchorRule: --x-palette-{role}-500 resolves to --x-ref-{role} for every role except neutral, which anchors at -1000 (page colour) — verbatim in codm.css.

manualStops.neutral: full 0-1000 ramp hand-tuned to match the prototype's existing UI greys (comment: 'neutral (== prototype greys)')

typePrimitives.fontBodyNote: codm.css declares body = Hitmarker Text VF at the top of the theme block, then overrides it to Inter in a later [data-theme="codm"] block (source-order win) — the LIVE resolved value is Inter; this spec records the final cascaded value, not the first declaration, so a naive diff of only the first block would be wrong.
typePrimitives.trackingNote: loose/wide carry a +5% Hitmarker compensation baked in (static-cut VF renders slightly tighter than the Figma source) — not the plain 0.5%/1% the master schema assumes.
typePrimitives.fontCondenseNote: Display text is squeezed 18% on the X axis to correct the static Hitmarker cut; --x-sys-font-condense-body is separately reset to 1 so body text (Inter) is NOT condensed.

radiusSteps.note: No radius overrides in codm.css — every surface uses the shared system.css/space.css scale unmodified (radius-control-full stays 2px, not pilled). This is itself a brand fact: COD:M does not use pill controls, unlike FCM.

effectGlow.note: --x-hdr-glow/-hot/-bloom (BestSellerCard running border + bloom) all alias the primary ramp — glow = --x-ref-primary itself.

hdr.effect: OKLCH lightness/chroma pushed past the sRGB ceiling on the HDR glow trio and the surface-l1-border gradient for a genuine glint on wide-gamut panels; SDR values are unaffected.

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Best-seller card gradient border + HDR glow
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: --x-hdr-glow / --x-hdr-hot / --x-hdr-bloom, all aliased to the primary palette ramp (not hardcoded), boosted further under @media (dynamic-range: high) via relative-colour syntax.

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Category / download banner full-border override
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: --x-category-banner-border / --x-download-banner-border set to a full border-all treatment (components default to bottom-only elsewhere) using the same neutral card-border colour as every flat surface.

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Sign-in-with-COD:M button fill
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: --x-bg-action-signin: oklch(0 0 0) — pure black, a pixel-parity override rather than a DS semantic slot.
